nodes.label: ADR 0011: Connector Trust Tiers
nodes.rationale: Full OCI isolation is correct for untrusted plugins but too heavy for a single first-party Chatwoot connector on day one, so a tiered trust model (Core/Tier0/Tier1/Deterministic transform) is used, with Chatwoot v1 restricted to a separately authenticated connector role with no direct DB/NATS/OpenFGA credentials.
